claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (one per top-ranked orthopedic institution)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials before vs after LLM rewriting to eighth-grade target
links.effect: Mean reading grade fell from 10.02 ± 1.86 to 5.67 ± 1.77; mean reduction 4.33 ± 1.50 (p < 0.001); all 25 rewritten PEMs below eighth-grade level.
links.quote: The average reduction in reading grade level was 4.33 ± 1.50 (p < 0.001), indicating a substantial improvement in the readability of the materials.

links.outcome: Readability and length of patient education materials after plain-language rewriting by generative AI
links.effect: Rewritten PEMs averaged 5.67 grade level versus 10.02 originally; word count fell from 755.0 to 312.2 (mean reduction 442.68, p < 0.001).
links.quote: Following the application of ChatGPT's rewriting tool, all 25 PEMs were revised to meet readability standards below the eighth-grade level.

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to rewrite existing verified patient education materials using CDC/NIH plain-language criteria
